success.description: M You enter into the dreaming mind of a mortal creature anywhere in the world. While that mortal’s dream, you may interact with him almost as if speaking face-to-face, although the entire experience is more surreal and less literal. You may use applicable social skills such as Charm or Guile to ask questions or influence the dreamer.

conservative.requirements: Requires: As part of working this blessing, you fall asleep and remain so for at least 6 hours. You must have a connection to the target, a portrait, true name, or personal item.
conservative.name: Dream Weaver

boon.description: You gain {Df} to checks to influence the dreamer.

chaosStar.description: You recover no stress, fatigue, or wounds from sleeping overnight.

reckless.requirements: Requires: As part of working this spell, you fall asleep and remain so for at least 6 hours. You must have a connection to the target, such as a portrait, true name, or personal item. Special: This blessing recharges at sundown.
